body.description: Cellet: a small chunky battery cell creature, copper top terminal like a hat, black and gold body with a charge meter on its belly, little stubby arms, sparks at its terminals, friendly giver. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
